$comment-dependencies: krb5 is declared here for ONE consumer: the community-extensions registry, which builds through vcpkg and has no system krb5 and no way to apt-install one. Local and CI builds discover the system library through pkg-config and ignore this manifest, so the declaration costs them nothing. It was deliberately empty before, on the reasoning that krb5 is a system library - true everywhere except the one place that has to build this from a clean container. Nothing else belongs here: sealing is done by the negotiated GSS security context, so there is no TLS library and none may be added for that purpose (constitution, Security & Data-Handling Constraints).
name: xmla-extension
